verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs show creating tasks through the API (quick start), and its official MCP server can 'create and manage tasks' and query 'incomplete tasks due this week', which implies due-date support. Developers in the community describe using Asana as their task-tracking tool. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of assigning tasks to teammates, explicit documentation of setting due dates on creation, hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-due-date workflow.
